description: This file defines the ResourcesModified event class, which is a specific implementation of a policy event in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It models an event indicating that a set of resources within a policy have been modified, including methods for creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and comparison.

classes.name: ResourcesModified
classes.description: An event class representing that resources associated with a policy have been modified. It includes details such as the policy ID, label, resources, revision, timestamp, and headers. Provides methods for construction from parameters or JSON, and for serialization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory methods to create instances of ResourcesModified, either with explicit parameters or from JSON.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance of ResourcesModified from a JSON string or object.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the policy entry that was modified.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the resources.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path to the resources in the event structure.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Creates a new instance with an updated revision number.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new instance with updated headers.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the event payload into a JSON object builder.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code for the event instance.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality of this event instance with another object.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper for equality check, ensuring the other object is an instance of ResourcesModified.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ResourcesModified instance.
